title: F12 Mesh Verifier and Genus-6 Edge Bridge

bridge.f12_interpretation: one Givens rotation for each unordered mode pair
bridge.genus6_interpretation: one edge for each unordered vertex pair in K12, or dually one adjacency edge for each unordered face pair

verdict: The 66-match is exact at the incidence-schedule level, not proof of a geometrically embedded genus-6 Csaszar/Szilassi realization.
boundary: This proves a shared complete-pair combinatorics. It does not prove the unknown geometric non-self-crossing genus-6 polyhedron exists.
